# Vibe

> A fast, minimal player for your music files on Mac. Plays audio files you
> own — on disk, or in a file provider such as iCloud Drive or Dropbox — with
> a seekable full-track waveform, a turntable-style pitch fader and DJ
> performance FX. It is not a streaming client: there is no catalogue, no
> library to import, no account and no subscription.

Vibe is a native macOS app written in Objective-C on CoreAudio and
AVAudioEngine, with no third-party audio engine. It is free, open source under
Apache 2.0, and available on the Mac App Store or as a direct download.

- Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later, Apple silicon or Intel.
- Formats: MP3, MP2, AAC, FLAC, MP4/M4A, QTA (Voice Memos), AIFF, WAV — all
  decoded by macOS itself, lossless at full resolution.
- No library or database: drop a file or folder on the window and it plays.
  Tags, artwork and BPM are read in the background and cached to disk.
- Files may live anywhere the Files system can reach — a local disk, an
  external drive, iCloud Drive, Dropbox or another file provider. Vibe asks
  the operating system to fetch a cloud file and shows its download progress;
  it never talks to the provider itself.
- For DJs: a turntable-style pitch fader, skips measured in bars rather than
  seconds when the tempo is known, and performance FX on the keyboard — a
  low-kill filter, a reverb wash, and delays locked to the track's BPM.
- Localized into 30 languages.
- Collects nothing, and has no network access of its own: the macOS sandbox
  carries no network-client entitlement, so the operating system will not
  permit an outbound connection. Cloud files are fetched by the provider's
  own system extension, not by Vibe.

## Links

- [Home](https://vibeplayer.app/): what the app is, with screenshots.
- [Privacy policy](https://vibeplayer.app/privacy): what Vibe stores locally,
  and why it cannot send anything anywhere.
- [Download (.dmg)](https://vibeplayer.app/download/latest): always the
  current notarized disk image — a redirect to the release asset on GitHub.
- [Release notes](https://github.com/cmicali/vibe/releases): every version,
  with what changed in each.
- [Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vibe-music-player/id1582482361?mt=12)
- [Source code](https://github.com/cmicali/vibe): Apache 2.0.
- [Support](https://vibeplayer.app/support): the GitHub issue tracker.
